title: Replacement System Installations: Included Protection, Upgrade Tiers and Manufacturer Parts Terms
content:
# Protection and manufacturer parts terms by package

Each Replacement System Installations package names the Harbison protection tier issued with the installation at no extra charge (besides the Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty), the higher protection tiers that may be added as a labor-warranty upgrade, and the manufacturer parts terms that depend on registration.

## Protection tiers

| Package | Protection tier included at no extra charge | Protection tiers available as a labor-warranty upgrade |
|---|---|---|
| Harbison Essential Series System | None | Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection; Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection; Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus |
| Harbison Advantage Series System | None | Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection; Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection; Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus |
| Harbison Performance Series System | Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection; Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus |
| Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System | Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection; Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus |
| Harbison Signature Series System | Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus |
| Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System | Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | Harbison 12-Year Total Protection; Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus |

## Manufacturer parts terms

| Package | Parts term when registered within the window (years) | Parts term when not registered within the window (years) | Registration window (calendar days after installation) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison Essential Series System | 10 | 5 | 60 |
| Harbison Advantage Series System | 10 | 5 | 60 |
| Harbison Performance Series System | 10 | 5 | 60 |
| Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System | 10 | 5 | 60 |
| Harbison Signature Series System | 10 | 5 | 60 |
| Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System | 10 | 5 | 60 |

## Reading the tables

- The upgrade list of a package contains only tiers above the tier it includes; the tier a package includes never appears in its own upgrade list.
- The parts terms and the registration window are the same for all six packages: 10 years registered, 5 years not registered, a 60-day window.
